name: FSR Upscaler
author: Echo-Storm
description: Off until you switch it on. Upscales with AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR 3.1, or FSR 4 from the Runtimes list) in place of Lossless Scaling's NIS scaler, on any graphics card, with the motion measured from the frames: choose NIS as the Scaling Type and run the game in a window smaller than the screen (at the screen's own size it anti-aliases). AMD's FSR runtime is included. Only one of the upscalers (DLSS, FSR, XeSS) works at a time.
